Rashi on Gittin 30a:12:1.hebrew: כשער הזול - שאם יוזלו חיטין בשעת הפרשת תרומות, אקבלם באותו השער של שעת הפרשה:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:12:1.english: According to the low [market] rate - [Meaning] that if wheat decreases in price at the time of separating terumot, I will accept them at that rate of the time of separation:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:12:2.hebrew: ואין בו משום רבית - בשאר פוסקין בעינן עד שיצא השער, וכאן פוסק בשעת הלואה בכך וכך, אף על פי שלא יצא השער:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:12:2.english: And this is not subject to [the prohibition of] interest - Regarding other [cases where people] contract [for future delivery], we require [that they wait] until the market price has been established, whereas here he contracts at the time of the loan for such-and-such [a price], even though the market price has not [yet] been established:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:13:1.english: And if he seeks to renege - [The Gemara] explains [this] later:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:13:2.hebrew: נתייאשו הבעלים - כגון שהלוהו כדי שיעור תרומות שנה זו, ועל מנת לקבלם בשנה זו, וראה שנשתדפו שדותיו, ונתייאש מאותה הלואה ואמר "ווי לחסרון כיס", ואחר כך חזרו ונתקנו — אין מפריש עליהם, דיאוש דבר האבד הוא:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:13:2.english: The owner despaired - For example, where he lent him [an amount] equal to the measure of this year's terumot, on condition to receive them [back] this year, and he saw that his fields were blighted, and he despaired of that loan and said, "Woe for the monetary loss!", and afterward they recovered — he may not separate [terumah] on their account, for [a case of] despair is [considered] something lost:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:14:1.hebrew: פוסק עמהם כשער הזול פשיטא - בכל תנאי נמי, אם בא לפסוק כשער הזול, מי ימחה בידו? גבי שאר פוסקין על הפירות נמי, הכי תניא באיזהו נשך (ב"מ דף עב:):
Rashi on Gittin 30a:14:1.english: He may contract with them according to the low [market] rate — isn't [that] obvious? - In any stipulation as well, if he comes to contract according to the low [market] rate, who would stop him? Regarding others who contract for produce as well, so it was taught in [the chapter] Eizehu Neshech (Bava Metzia 72b):

Rashi on Gittin 30a:14:2.hebrew: כמי שפסק דמי - וה"ק: הפיסוק שהוא פוסק עמהן, כשער הזול הוא, שאם יוזלו מדמים הללו שהוא פוסק בשעת הלוואה, יקבלם כשער הזול:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:14:2.english: He is considered like one who stipulated - And this is what [the Gemara] is saying: The stipulation that he makes with them is [according to] the lower rate — [meaning] that if they drop in price from this amount that he stipulates at the time of the loan, he will receive them at the lower rate:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:15:1.english: That when he does not have [any] - for example, if his fields were blighted:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:16:1.english: We do not read regarding it, "he shall not exact" - for he cannot demand anything from him:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:17:1.hebrew: בעל הבית - אם בא לחזור בכהן, אין יכול, שהרי כספו בידו, וזה לא היה לו למשוך ממנו כלום, דלימא ליה "לא משכתי":
Rashi on Gittin 30a:17:1.english: A homeowner - If [the homeowner] seeks to renege on the priest, he cannot [do so], for his money is in [the priest's] hand, and [the homeowner] did not have anything to pull from him such that he could say to him, "I did not pull".

Rashi on Gittin 30a:17:2.hebrew: אבל כהן חוזר בו - דכיון דעשאוהו כזוכה, יכול לטעון: "לא משכת ממני פירות":
Rashi on Gittin 30a:17:2.english: However, a priest may renege - since [the Rabbis] treated him as one who takes possession [of the money], he can claim: "You have not pulled produce from me."

Rashi on Gittin 30a:18:1.hebrew: לא צריכא דאקון - בשעה שייבשו ונתייאש, כבר עלו בקנה:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:18:1.english: No, [it is] necessary [where] they formed stalks - At the time when they [the crops] dried out and he [the owner] despaired, they had already grown into a stalk:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:18:2.hebrew: מהו דתימא אקנתא מילתא היא - דמשעלו בקנה, אם מתייבשים — חוזרים ומתקנים, ומלתא דלא שכיחא הוא שיהו מתקלקלין לגמרי, ולא הוי יאוש מעליא; קמ"ל:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:18:2.english: What might you have said, [that] akanta [the growth of a stalk] is a significant matter - For once [the crops] have grown into a stalk, if they dry out, they recover, and it is an uncommon thing for them to be completely ruined, so it is not a valid despair; [therefore, the baraita] teaches us [otherwise]:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:19:1.hebrew: אותו השבט - שהקרוב להם באותו השבט ראוי ליורשם, וכל לויים זוכין במעשרות, לפיכך יעכב זה את המעשרות בשביל הקרוב להם בלוייה:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:19:1.english: That tribe - For the one closest to them in that tribe is fit to inherit them, and all Levites are entitled to tithes; therefore, this [lender] may withhold the tithes on behalf of the one closest to them in the Levitical [tribe]:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:19:2.hebrew: בחזקת עניי ישראל - הכא ליכא למימר "בחזקת יורשין", שמא יורשים עשירים הם; אבל בחזקת שאר עניים יפריש ויעכבם, דהואיל ותקנת עניים הוא, ניחא להו לכל עניי ישראל שתהא דת זו נוהגת בישראל, כדי שימצאו מלוים להם כשיצטרכו; הלכך כי גבי משאר עניים, לאו גוזל את העניים הוא:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:19:2.english: With the presumption of the poor of Israel - Here one cannot say "with the presumption of [his] heirs," lest [his] heirs are wealthy; rather, with the presumption of the rest of the poor, he separates [the tithes] and retains them [as repayment], for since it is an enactment for [the benefit of] the poor, it is satisfactory to all the poor of Israel that this practice be followed in Israel, so that they will find [people] to lend to them when they need [it]; therefore, when he collects from [the share of] the rest of the poor, he is not robbing the poor.

Rashi on Gittin 30a:1:1.hebrew: כי משוו ב"ד שליח - מי בעי בפניו דשליח קמא, או אפילו שלא בפניו, כגון זה שהוא אנוס ואינו יכול לעכב כאן וילך לדרכו:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:1:1.english: When the court appoints an agent - Do we require [that it be] in the presence of the first agent, or even not in his presence — such as this [case] where he is constrained [by circumstances] and cannot remain here, and [so] goes on his way:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:2:1.hebrew: מברא - מעבר המים, שלא מצא את המעבורת:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:2:1.english: The ferry - the crossing of the water, [meaning] that he did not find the ferryboat:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:2:2.hebrew: לא שמיה מתיא - דלא מטי עד הכא, ואין טענת אונס בתנאי גיטין למימר "אניסנא". א"נ יש אונס בגיטין — הא אוקימנא בשמעתא קמייתא דכתובות דהאי אונסא דשכיח הוא, ואיבעי ליה לאתנויי:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:2:2.english: It is not considered an arrival - For he did not reach all the way here, and there is no claim of unavoidable accident regarding conditions in bills of divorce to say, "I was unavoidably prevented." Alternatively, [even if] there is [a claim of] unavoidable accident in bills of divorce — we have already established in the first sugya of [Tractate] Ketubot that this is a common [type of] unavoidable circumstance, and he should have made a stipulation [for it]:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:3:1.hebrew: ליהוי גיטא - מעכשיו אמסור לה גט על תנאי זה, אי לא אפייס לה:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:3:1.english: Let it be a bill of divorce - [Meaning:] From now, I will hand over a bill of divorce to her on this condition: if I do not appease her:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:3:2.hebrew: פייסה - בדברים, והרבה עליה ריעים, ולא נתרצתה להשלים אתו:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:3:2.english: He appeased her - with words, and sent many friends to [plead with] her, but she did not agree to reconcile with him:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:3:3.hebrew: מי יהב לה תרקבא דדינרי ולא איפייסא - וכיון שלא עשה כן, נמצא שלא פייסה; ואע"פ שאין לו, לא אמרינן אניס, דאין אדם יכול לטעון אונס בתנאי של גט, והוי גיטא:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:3:3.english: Did he give her a tarkeva [a large vessel] of dinars and she was not appeased? - And since he did not do so, it turns out that he did not appease her; and even though he does not have [the means], we do not say [that he is] under unavoidable constraint [anis], because a person cannot claim [exemption due to] unavoidable circumstances [ones] in a condition of a bill of divorce, and [therefore] it is a [valid] bill of divorce:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:4:1.hebrew: אטו תרקבא דדינרי בעי למיתב לה - והרי אין לו, ואנוס הוא, דהא פייסה במה שבידו לעשות ולא איפייסא, ולא הוי גיטא, דיש אונס בגיטין:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:4:1.english: Must he give her a tarkav [measure] of dinars - [No,] for he does not have [it], and he is [considered] prevented by unavoidable circumstance, since he appeased her with what was in his power to do and she was not appeased; thus it is not a [valid] bill of divorce, because [the claim of] unavoidable circumstance applies to bills of divorce:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:5:1.hebrew: הא כמאן דאמר כו' - פלוגתא דתרי לישני ואליבא דרבא היא, במסכת כתובות בשמעתא קמייתא:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:5:1.english: This [is] according to the one who says, etc. - It is a dispute of two versions according to Rava, in Tractate Ketubot, in the opening discussion [shema'ta]:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:6:1.hebrew: להיות מפריש עליהן מחלקן - המלוה הזה, כשיפריש תרומותיו, ימכור התרומה ויעכב הדמים לעצמו בפרעון החוב — זה בשביל הכהן, וכן המעשר ראשון בשביל לוי, ומעשר עני בשביל עני; והמעשרות יעכב ויאכל, אלא שמפריש מעשר מן המעשר לכהן, שהן מותרין לזרים, מכיון שאין כאן גזל מתנות שכבר נתן דמיהם לכהן זה, ובשעת ההלואה פסק להם דמים:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:6:1.english: To separate on their behalf from their portion - When this lender separates his terumah portions, he sells the terumah and keeps the money for himself in repayment of the debt — this [is done] for the priest, and similarly [he separates] the first tithe for a Levite and the poor man's tithe for a poor person. And the tithes he may keep and eat, except that he separates a tithe from the tithe for a priest, for they [the remaining tithes] are permitted to non-priests, since there is no robbery of [the] gifts here, as he already gave their value to this priest, and at the time of the loan he fixed a price for them:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:7:1.hebrew: ליטול רשות מן היורשין - מפני שאין חוב זה מוטל עליהן לפרוע, יטול מהם רשות: אם רוצים שיתקבל חובו בשבילם, יעכבם ממעשרות עצמו:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:7:1.english: To obtain permission from the heirs - Because this debt is not incumbent upon them to pay, he must obtain permission from them: if they want his debt to be collected on their behalf, he may withhold them [the tithes] from his own tithes:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:7:2.hebrew: אינו צריך ליטול רשות - דיש כח לב"ד להטיל חוב זה על כל הכהונה והלויה, לפי שתקנתם הוא שימצאו מעות להלואה:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:7:2.english: He does not need to obtain permission - because the court has the power to impose this debt upon the entire priesthood and the Levites, since it is for their benefit, so that they will find money to borrow:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:8:1.hebrew: ואע"ג דלא אתו לידיה - בתמיה: אע"פ שאינו נותנן לכהן ויחזירם לו, קתני מתני' דיפריש עליהן; וכיון דלא מטו לידיה, מאן זכי ליה להאי כהן הך תרומה שיקבלנה זה בחובו, והיאך יצא ידי נתינה:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:8:1.english: And even though they did not come into his possession - [This is asked] in astonishment: even though he does not give them to the priest so that [the priest] may return them to him, the Mishnah teaches that he may separate [the tithes] on their behalf! And since they did not reach his possession, who acquires this terumah on behalf of this priest such that this [creditor] may receive it for his debt, and how has he fulfilled [the obligation of] giving?

Rashi on Gittin 30a:9:1.hebrew: במכרי כהונה - כמו "איש מאת מכרו" (מלכים ב י״ב:ו׳), שהם מכיריו ואוהביו, דאינו רגיל לתת תרומות ומעשרות אלא לכהן זה; הלכך, כיון דמלתא דפשיטא היא דלדידהו יהיב להו, אסחי להו שאר כהני דעתייהו, והוה כמאן דמטו לידייהו דהני:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:9:1.english: With regard to associates of the priesthood - as in [the verse] "each man from his acquaintance" (II Kings 12:6), [meaning] that they are his acquaintances and friends, for he is accustomed to giving terumot and tithes only to this priest; therefore, since it is a clear matter that he gives them to these [priests], the other priests give up expectation of [receiving] them, and it is as though [the gifts] have already reached the hands of these [priests]:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:9:2.hebrew: במזכה להן ע"י אחרים - כשהוא מפריש, מוסרו למעשרות ביד אוהבו ואומר: "זכי במעשר זה לפלוני לוי", והוה ליה כמאן דמטא לידיה, וחוזר ומחזירן לו:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:9:2.english: With regard to one who has [them] acquire through others - When he separates [them], he hands the tithes over into the hand of his friend and says, "Acquire this tithe on behalf of so-and-so the Levite," and it is [considered] as though it had reached his [the Levite's] hand, and [the friend] then returns them to him [the lender]:

Rashi on Gittin 30a:9:3.hebrew: עשו את שאינו זוכה כזוכה - במקומות הרבה מפני תקנה עשו כן לרבי יוסי: בהניזקין (לקמן גיטין דף נט:) — עני המנקף בראש הזית, ומצודות חיות ועופות, ומציאת חרש; ובבכורות (דף יח:) — כל שחליפיו ביד כהן פטור מן המתנות; ובגמרא דשנים אוחזין (ב"מ דף יב:) — השוכר את הפועל ילקט בנו אחריו, דאף על פי שאין זכיה לקטן עשאוהו כזוכה; ובכולן י"ל מפני תקנה עשו:
Rashi on Gittin 30a:9:3.english: They rendered one who does not acquire like one who acquires - In many places, they did so because of an enactment according to Rabbi Yosei: in [the chapter] HaNizakin (later, Gittin 59b) — [the cases of] a poor person beating [olives] at the top of the olive tree, traps for wild animals and birds, and the found object of a deaf-mute; and in Bekhorot (18b) — [the case of] anything whose exchange is in the hand of a priest is exempt from the [priestly] gifts; and in the Gemara of [the chapter] Shenayim Ochazin (Bava Metzia 12b) — [the case of] one who hires a worker, his son may glean after him, for even though a minor has no [power of] acquisition, they rendered him like one who acquires; and in all of them, one can say they did [so] because of an enactment:

Tosafot on Gittin 30a:10:1.hebrew: במכרי לא קתני - אע"ג דמזכה נמי לא קתני, מ"מ ניחא ליה לאוקמי במזכה, דאיירי בכל כהנים. ומאן דמוקי לה במכרי משום דמזכה לא קתני, אע"ג דמכרי נמי לא קתני, משמע ליה "מפרישין עליהן" סתם, בלא שום זיכוי:
Tosafot on Gittin 30a:10:1.english: [It] does not teach regarding acquaintances - Even though "one who transfers possession" is also not taught, nevertheless it is preferable to him to establish [the Mishnah] as referring to one who transfers possession, since it applies to all priests. And as for the one who establishes it as referring to acquaintances because "one who transfers possession" is not taught — even though "acquaintances" is also not taught, it seems to him [that the phrase] "one separates on their behalf" [implies] simply [doing so], without any transfer of possession:

Tosafot on Gittin 30a:10:2.hebrew: כיחידאה לא מוקמינן - אע"ג דשמואל פסיק בפ"ק דב"מ (דף יב.) כרבי יוסי, דעשו את שאינו זוכה כזוכה, מכל מקום מסתבר ליה לאוקמי מתניתין אפילו כרבנן:
Tosafot on Gittin 30a:10:2.english: We do not establish [it] in accordance with an individual [opinion] - Even though Shmuel rules in the first chapter of Bava Metzia (12a) in accordance with Rabbi Yosei, that they treated one who cannot acquire as one who can acquire, nevertheless, it seems more reasonable to him to establish our Mishnah even in accordance with the Rabbis:

Tosafot on Gittin 30a:12:1.hebrew: ופוסק עמהן כשער הזול - כדמפ' דאע"ג דלא פסק, כמי שפסק דמי; ואין בו משום רבית, אפילו פוסק הרבה פחות משער הזול:
Tosafot on Gittin 30a:12:1.english: And he may contract with them according to the low [market] rate - As [the Gemara] explains, that even though he did not contract [explicitly], it is as though he had contracted; and it is not subject to [the prohibition of] interest, even if he contracts [for a price] much lower than the low [market] rate:

Tosafot on Gittin 30a:14:1.hebrew: הא קמ"ל אע"ג דלא פסק כו' - וא"ת, הא נמי פשיטא, דבפרק איזהו נשך (בבא מציעא דף עב:) אמר ר' יהודה שיכול לומר לו: "תן לי כזה, או תן לי מעותי"! וי"ל, דהתם שאומר לו בשעת הזול, אבל הכא אפילו שתק עד שהוקר השער:
Tosafot on Gittin 30a:14:1.english: This teaches us [that] even though he did not contract, etc. - And if you ask: This too is obvious, for in the chapter [entitled] Eizehu Neshekh (Bava Metzia 72b), Rabbi Yehuda said that he can say to him, "Give me like this, or give me my money!" And one can answer that there [it is a case] where he says [this] to him at the time of the low price, whereas here [it applies] even if he remained silent until the price rose:

Tosafot on Gittin 30a:15:1.hebrew: כיון דכי לית ליה לא יהיב ליה כו' - והא דאסר רב בפרדיסא באיזהו נשך (שם דף עג.), אע"ג דאית ביה תיוהא, הכא התירו משום תקנת כהן:
Tosafot on Gittin 30a:15:1.english: Since, when he has none, he does not give him, etc. - And [as for] that which Rav forbade [buying the produce of] an orchard [in advance] in [the chapter entitled] Eizehu Neshekh (Bava Metzia 73a), even though there is risk of loss in it — here they permitted [it] because of an enactment for [the benefit of] the priest:

Tosafot on Gittin 30a:17:1.hebrew: לא שנו אלא בעל הבית בכהן - אפילו לרבנן דפליגי ארבי שמעון בפ' הזהב (בבא מציעא דף מד.), ולית להו "כל שהכסף בידו ידו על העליונה", הכא לא גרע מכי לית ליה לא יהיב. אי נמי כדפירש בקונטרס, דהכא דאין לו למשוך ממנו כלום, לא מצי הדר ביה:
Tosafot on Gittin 30a:17:1.english: They taught [this] only [with regard to] a homeowner with a priest - Even according to the Rabbis who disagree with Rabbi Shimon in the chapter [entitled] HaZahav (Bava Metzia 44a) and do not hold [the principle] "whoever has the money in his hand has the upper hand," here it is no worse than [the case] where, when he does not have [produce], he does not give [anything]. Alternatively, [it is] as Rashi explained: that here, since he has nothing to pull from him, he cannot renege:

Tosafot on Gittin 30a:3:1.hebrew: מי יהיב לה תרקבא דדינרי ולא איפייסא - אע"ג דלית ליה, אין טענת אונס בגיטין, והוי גט. וא"ת: וכי יהב לה נמי תרקבא דדינרי, אמאי לא הוי גיטא? הא לא איפייסא! ואור"י: ד"אי לא פייסנא לה" משמע אם לא אטרח לפייסה בדבר גדול, ואי יהב לה, הרי טרח לפייסה וקיים תנאו, אע"פ שלא נתפייסה:
Tosafot on Gittin 30a:3:1.english: Did he give her a tarkeva of dinars and she was not appeased? - Even though he does not have [the money], there is no claim of unavoidable circumstance in [matters of] bills of divorce, and it is a [valid] bill of divorce. And if you ask: Even if he had given her a tarkeva of dinars, why would it not be a [valid] bill of divorce? Behold, she was not appeased! And Rabbeinu Yitzchak says that "if I do not appease her" means: if I do not exert myself to appease her with something substantial; and if he gives [it] to her, he has indeed exerted himself to appease her and fulfilled his condition, even though she was not appeased:
